commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=25153fc52bb5a95d5a85ea44a0bd4b29b2930d96; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; TOKEN=$(python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))'); PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()'); TMP=$(mktemp -d); BROKER=''; TUNNEL=''; cleanup(){ [ -z "$TUNNEL" ] || kill "$TUNNEL" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -z "$TUNNEL" ] || wait "$TUNNEL" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -z "$BROKER" ] || kill "$BROKER" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -z "$BROKER" ] || wait "$BROKER" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy-never-used AI_CALL_BRIDGE_BROKER_TOKEN="$TOKEN" python3 scripts/realtime_credential_broker.py --port "$PORT" >"$TMP/broker.out" 2>"$TMP/broker.err" & BROKER=$!; READY=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" || true); if [ "$CODE" = 405 ]; then READY=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; test "$READY" = 1; SUCCESS=0; for ATTEMPT in 1 2 3; do LOG="$TMP/tunnel-$ATTEMPT.err"; cloudflared tunnel --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --no-autoupdate >"$TMP/tunnel-$ATTEMPT.out" 2>"$LOG" & TUNNEL=$!; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 120); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[a-z0-9-]+[.]trycloudflare[.]com' "$LOG" | head -n1 || true); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; if [ -n "$URL" ]; then set +e; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import sys; from realtime_offcall_lab import wait_for_public_broker; wait_for_public_broker(sys.argv[1] + "/v1/realtime/client-secret", timeout_seconds=30)' "$URL"; RC=$?; set -e; if [ "$RC" = 0 ]; then SUCCESS=1; break; fi; fi; kill "$TUNNEL" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$TUNNEL" 2>/dev/null || true; TUNNEL=''; done; test "$SUCCESS" = 1; echo public_broker_unauthorized_boundary_green=true; echo long_lived_key_upstream_not_used=true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
